findings.description: Russian ICU category one includes 21 and 101, not just exactly one. The singular action branch therefore says to remove one tag while the actual action clears all assignments.
findings.evidence: Installed intl-messageformat with ru renders count=21 as «Удалить тег (21)» and count=101 as «Удалить тег (101)»; count=2 renders «Удалить все теги (2)». Intl.PluralRules(ru).select(21) returns one. chat-sidebar.tsx passes the number of distinct assigned tag IDs and invokes moveChatToTag(row, untagged), clearing all.
findings.recommendation: Use an exact =1 branch for «Удалить тег (#)» and other for «Удалить все теги (#)»; Russian one is not an exact-one predicate.
